audience: property managers and leasing teams that run apartment communities on Resi

useCases.title: Find units available for rent
useCases.text: List the available units in a rent range. Open one unit to see its fees, amenities and synced fields.

useCases.title: Review new leads and their sources
useCases.text: List the newest leads and open one to see its tour booking and submission. Use lead data only for the client's own leasing work.

useCases.title: Find out why a PMS sync failed
useCases.text: List the connections to the property management system (PMS) and CRM, then read the sync logs of one connection. Logs are kept 14 days.

useCases.title: Read reviews of a property
useCases.text: Find the property, then list its resident and public reviews with rating, source and publish state.

useCases.title: Update a unit's rent or availability
useCases.text: Read the unit first. A field in synced_fields is overwritten by the next PMS sync. Then change rent, availability, deposit or specials. The change goes live on the client's Resi sites. Needs a Full access token.
